name: veterinary_clinic_system_092_idempotent_occupancy_sync
instruction: Sync the boarding board so runs exactly mirror the reservation book, idempotently: after your changes, a run must be 'occupied' with current_patient_id set IFF a checked_in reservation references it (patient from that reservation); runs with no checked_in reservation must be 'available' with current_patient_id null — EXCEPT runs whose status is 'maintenance', which stay 'maintenance' with null occupant. Add field synced='<batch_code>' ONLY to runs you actually changed. Running the sync twice must change nothing the second time (the tag must already match the current batch_code — do not re-stamp).

success_criteria.summary: Compute expected run state from live reservations; assert invariant holds for all 17 runs; assert synced tags == nonce on exactly the diff set computed from snapshot; all other runs byte-identical. QC: gold twice -> second pass zero changes (verified by rerunning verifier and by identical hashes).

checks.expect: Compute expected run state from live reservations; assert invariant holds for all 17 runs; assert synced tags == nonce on exactly the diff set computed from snapshot; all other runs byte-identical. QC
